title: plt run inputs
description: A run's inputs.yaml — what the launcher declared. Closed: the file is hand-authored, so a key nobody reads is a typo. Nothing is required: a card run is keyed by `card`, a review run by `pr`, and the run id itself names the run either way.

pr.description: The PR number, or its URL. Both forms are live and every reader takes either: facts.prNumber, digest and render each match `pull/<n>` before falling back to a bare number, and render links the run by this URL when it is one.

repo.description: The run's PR repo as owner/name. facts.findPrRepo reads it first, before the owner/name in a `pr` URL and the config default (links.pr_repo), so a run in a second repo never reads another repo's PR of the same number.
